Enabled.description: Permit local origin-level collection in this managed browser profile.

AllowedOrigins.description: Exact HTTPS origins enabled by the administrator.

RetentionDays.description: Keep origin and UTC day locally for this many calendar days, including today. Defaults to 7.

CentralReportingEnabled.description: Allow this profile to enroll separately for daily origin reporting to the packaged control plane.

UploadBlockingEnabled.description: Apply upload controls to explicitly selected supported routes in this managed profile. Defaults to false.

UploadBlockingRoutes.description: Exact HTTPS file-upload endpoints for the enabled origins, up to eight. No wildcards or query strings.
